what: When the mouse enters the panel, thin crosshair lines across the panel, a + mark and X/Y coordinates (pixels inside the panel) appear in .25s and follow the mouse with a lag — each 60fps frame closes .3 of the remaining distance. The faster it moves, the more the + grows and the lines darken slightly. A tip note sticks to the lower right of the + and disappears on the first click. It fades out in .25s on leave — a tool for spotting violations on a design drawing

options.lerp: Share caught up per frame, default .3

use: Press and drag to find the violations
note: Line and + colors are --kf-ink and --kf-accent, the note is --kf-contrast-bg/ink. Not applied on touch devices (no hover) or with reduced motion

from.where: index.html .hi-hero__img — original home-hero-img-interact: crosshair x/y eased by .3 per frame, coordinates +23/−14px, hint +68/+21px, autoAlpha .25s power2.out
